pkgmetadata.longdescription: Wine built from the same sources and options as wine-vanilla, plus the AdobeWine patchset (MSHTML/MSXML, Direct2D, DirectWrite, heap, WinHTTP and WinRT fixes) that lets the Adobe Creative Cloud installer, Adobe sign-in and apps such as Photoshop run. It is slotted like the other Wine variants and selectable with eselect wine; app-emulation/adobewine uses it for its prefix.

use.flag: Enable support for running x86_64 applications on arm64 via binary translation
Use sys-devel/crossdev for the toolchain rather than dev-util/mingw64-toolchain
Use the user's CFLAGS for the PE (Windows) parts instead of safe defaults
Pull in games-emulation/dosbox to run DOS applications
Enable mshtml support using app-emulation/wine-gecko (needed by the Creative Cloud installer)
Build the PE parts with MinGW (needed for most features)
Use libnetapi from net-fs/samba for the netapi32 DLL
Pull in net-fs/samba with winbind for NTLM auth support
Enable 32-bit support through the new WoW64 mode
